source.name: figure-fixture
source.origin: Controlled integration fixture; the other three entries are unmodified upstream documents.

policy: Same page count/dimensions; at least .995 reference AND GPU ink covered within a one-pixel x/y neighbourhood (white background excluded); every connected ink component of at least two pixels has >=.95 local coverage; every native glyph matched by identity and within 1px, size within .1px; no missing/extra/unmeasured glyphs; image boxes within 1px. Exact RGB and the earlier Euclidean boundary criterion remain separately recorded. No alignment, crop or page exclusions.
geometryPolicy: One-to-one native font/glyph matching on each original page; position <=1px, font size <=.1px; no missing, extra or unmeasured glyphs. Vector-only tiles are checked by pixels.
scope: Forced software WebGPU. Each timed run forces fresh independent layout from original TeX; warm atlas/pipeline, no cached layout; reference PDFs are comparison targets and never runtime inputs. CPU PDF compile and GPU render timings measure different output stages. Pixel comparisons use a separate untimed GPU readback, without CSS screenshot resampling.
